The '''ancient Muun tongue''' was a ancient<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Trade language/Legends|trade language]] used by the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The name of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], which the Muuns named, meant "[[Gemstone/Legends|gem]]" in the trade [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ancient Muun tongue was first mentioned, albeit unnamed, in [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]]'s [[2009]] reference book, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], by [[James Luceno]], later identified it as such.<ref name="Plagueis" />
